title: Add POST /login endpoint in user controller
description:
As a user, I want to login to the account that I have already created.

 The endpoint must:
- Accept email and passsword use seperate DTOs like create account.
- Returns access to user portfolio of logged in user and 200 OK status when email and password match otherwise, login information is incorrect return message login failed.
acceptance_criteria:
1. GET /login returns HTTP 200 with a message: 'login successful' if creds are correct or 'login failed' if creds are incorrect.
2. Unit tests cover: invalid login creds and login creds
